 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rare_limit = max(8, (h * w) // 8)
    marker_colors = {c for c, n in counts.items() if c != background and n <= rare_limit}
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r][c] in marker_colors for c in range(w))]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] in marker_colors for r in range(h))]
    return [[grid[r1][c1] if grid[r1][c1] == grid[r1][c2] == grid[r2][c1] == grid[r2][c2] else background
             for c1, c2 in zip(cols, cols[1:])]
            for r1, r2 in zip(rows, rows[1:])]
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
